subject: Intro: quick fit questions + compact demo (ShopHopper)
messages:
From: signup@redwood.inference
To: elena@shophopper.ai, tom@shophopper.ai
Date: 2026-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — next steps

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference. You can explore the console immediately; if you'd like a short product walkthrough, reply to this email and an SDR will reach out to schedule a 20–30 minute demo focused on your use case.

—The Redwood Onboarding Team
attachments: none

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@shophopper.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-17T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick fit questions before a short demo

Hi Elena — congrats on signing up, and welcome! I'm Naomi on the SDR team. Quick ask so we can make the demo concrete and keep it to ~25 minutes: could you answer the three bullets below? If it's easier, paste rough numbers. Once we have this, I'll send 3 compact slots (20–30m) and tailor it to architecture + security + a short live walkthrough.

- Primary use case (what you'll build in week 1 vs. month 3)?
- Current/expected traffic (baseline today, peak burst; avg tokens/request if known)?
- Target timeline to go from POC -> production (weeks)? Any compliance requirements (SAML/SSO, data residency)?

Also: do you prefer a technical + infra-focused demo (architect, infra lead included) or product-first (PM + sketch of flows)?

I can offer: Tue 5/19 10:00–10:30 PDT, Wed 5/20 2:00–2:30 PDT, or Thu 5/21 8:30–9:00 PDT. If none work, send 2 windows and we'll adapt. Calendar link: https://cal.com/naomi_feldman/30min

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman | SDR, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Elena Park <elena@shophopper.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-17T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick fit questions before a short demo

Hi Naomi — thanks for the quick follow-up. Short answers below (happy to expand in the call):

- Use case: Customer support triage + automated summarization, plus an embeddings-backed search for our knowledge base. POC will prototype message-level summarization and reranking; production will integrate into support UI and webhook processing.
- Traffic: today we have ~200 live queries/day on staging. We expect to ramp to ~50k queries/day over 8–10 weeks after integration. Typical query size is 150–400 tokens; peak concurrency unknown but we see brief bursts (minutes) during campaign spikes — rough peak 120 concurrent requests.
- Timeline & compliance: goal is POC in 2–3 weeks, production in ~10 weeks. We require SAML SSO (Okta) and audit logs; data residency in US is preferred but not strictly required for POC.

I've attached a short sample of our anonymized traffic profile to illustrate dayparts and burstiness (shophopper_traffic_may.csv). For the demo: please keep it technical — I'll include our infra lead Tom (cc'ed) if possible.

Thanks — Elena
Elena Park | Head of Platform, ShopHopper
elena@shophopper.ai
attachments: shophopper_traffic_may.csv (CSV, 22KB)

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@shophopper.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Tom Reyes <tom@shophopper.ai>
Date: 2026-05-17T12:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick fit questions before a short demo

Perfect — this is great context, thanks for the file. A couple of quick clarifications so we can prep the right demo assets:

- When you say 50k queries/day, is that evenly distributed or concentrated in campaigns? If campaign-driven, what's the largest sustained 5–10 minute RPS you expect (ballpark)?
- For tokens/request: is 150 the typical or the lower bound? We'll use conservative estimates for RAM/KV caching sizing.
- Okta SAML + audit logs are supported; we'll include a brief slide on SSO flows. Any specific log retention or export requirements?

Priyom (cc) will join the call on the infra path — Priyom, would you prep a brief on our autoscale and burst routing so Elena can see how we handle minute-scale spikes?

If the earlier slots work we can lock — otherwise propose Wed 5/20 11:00–11:30 PDT or Fri 5/22 9:00–9:30 PDT.

—Naomi

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Park <elena@shophopper.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-17T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Re: Re: Re: Welcome to Redwood — quick fit questions before a short demo

Thanks, Elena — I reviewed the CSV quickly. It looks like you have clear daypart peaks around 10:00–12:00 and 18:00–19:00 UTC, with campaign spikes that reach ~250 rps for short windows. For the demo I'll cover: our burst routing, autoscale thresholds, and KV/prefix caching strategies that reduce per-token cost during repeats.

Locking Wed 5/20 11:00–11:30 PDT for a technical + infra session. Sending calendar invite to both.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.ai
attachments: calendar_invite.ics (iCal, 2KB)
